area: Upton Park / East Ham border: a north-south '...ST' road and 'LANE' on the W, Bristol Road, Stafford Road, York Road, Rutland Road, Chester Road, two Board Schools (Boys Girls & Infants), P.H., Congregational Chapel (Seats for 400) at the S edge, '...BURY' road at the NE corner
method: Viewed full 1024 px mosaic (anchor: York Road, Congregational Chapel), then all 9 sweep crops at 2x, each anchored as opened: r0c0 'ST' road and L A N E; r0c1 BRISTOL/STAFFORD; r0c2 School/'...BURY'; r1c0 P.H./L.B./'...Y ROAD'; r1c1 YORK ROAD/RUTLAND; r1c2 York Road B.M.35.40/Rutland Road; r2c0 west School/large 'A S'; r2c1 Congregational Chapel; r2c2 CHESTER ROAD/large 'E T'. Zoom contact sheets (own helper, mosaic-px labels): a 8x (32.1, 31.5, 30.4, 29.5, 32.9, B.M.34.71), b 8x (B.M.37.34, 35.8, 34.4, 30.2, B.M.32.29, 30.5), c 8x (30.4, 31.4, 32.8, B.M.35.40, 30.1, 29.4), d 8x (28.9, 29.8, B.M.33.69, 32.9), e 12x digit checks, f 16x 3/8 comparisons, g 14x east-edge figure and B.M.37.34 pheon, h 8x east-edge cut figure; four 2x marker sheets (quadrants) checking every position. Every image displayed when opened.
legibility: Clear print; road-name lettering is widely spaced without interpuncts, so most dots are survey dots. 3 vs 8 is the main hazard: several final digits look 8-like at 12-16x, but they are read as 3 or 8 by comparing loop shape with 3s in the same figure. Sheet joins at: horizontal py ~951-954 across the full width (tint step and line, confirmed by eye).
